cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Every Loss Builds the Comeback
cards.instruction: Treat each setback as proof that the eventual victory will be more impressive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Three penalties will make our trophy photo better. I blew my whistle whenever the referee did.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You aren't a referee. They penalized us because you kept stopping play.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly, making a comeback worth watching. Wait till I lead us out of last place.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The team has asked me to captain. They still want you cheering from the sideline.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: From the sideline to the trophy photo, then. Give me your loudest cheer; I'll show them what support sounds like.

reason: Replace the unsupported Stance overlay with a concrete mistaken imitation whose correction redirects A's exact Drive pursuit; distinguish the alternative's relationship and immediate pressure.
